summary: Iteration 2 backend regression for Foundry rebrand + anti-hallucination guardrails + expanded 11-model OpenRouter fallback chain. Extended iteration_1 suite from 18 to 20 tests: added compliance disclaimer guardrail check and unknown-agent fallback check. All 20/20 tests passed against public preview URL. One transient 502 (infra/preview gateway, not code) was observed during the first run on /agents/chat and self-resolved on retry — recorded as flaky, not a bug.

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 'preview environment is not responding' on first call after idle (~1/2 runs). Self-resolved on retry. Likely preview-gateway cold start, not application code.

verifications.GET /api/agents lists 9 agents: PASS (research, compliance, brand, profile, operations, sop, marketing, sales_gym, general)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: server.py call_openrouter falls through on ANY non-200 (e.g., 401/403/400), not just 429/5xx — the comment says 'Try next model only on 429/5xx' but the code does not branch. If OPENROUTER_API_KEY is invalid you'll burn through all 11 models before failing. Consider short-circuiting on 401/403.
Minor: agent_chat persists every chat turn but there is no GET /api/chats endpoint — chats collection grows without retrieval path. Either add a history endpoint or drop the write.
Minor: get_profile returns Optional[Profile]; FastAPI serializes Python None as JSON null which works, but a 404 would be more idiomatic for a missing profile.

Nit: agents.py mutates AGENTS at import time to append GUARDRAILS — re-importing in tests is fine but if anything ever calls agents.py as a script twice the guardrail block would be appended twice. Apply once via a flag or build a derived dict.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rebrand assert Vula->Foundry, +2 new tests: compliance disclaimer, unknown-agent fallback)
seed_data_creation: All test data uses TEST_ prefix and a unique TEST_sess_<uuid> session_id; cleaned up by test_zz_cleanup at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is the canonical regression suite (20 tests, ~60s on warm preview, ~100s if cold). Public URL: https://startup-forge-79.preview.emergentagent.com/api. The /api/agents/chat endpoint can return a transient 502 from the preview gateway on first hit after idle — retry once before flagging as a bug. The compliance guardrail test does substring matching on 'licensed professional' / 'qualified professional' / 'legal professional' — tolerant to LLM phrasing drift.
rca of the issue: n/a — no application bugs. The single 502 observed on first run was a preview-gateway timeout (body literally said 'The preview environment is not responding. It may be starting up.'); the retry passed in 31s with status 200. Not a backend regression.
